# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the documentation, example, reproduction, or compatibility-note change.

## Verification

Describe the checks you ran and, for examples, the expected OpenAPI Guard result.

## Public-content checklist

- [ ] This contribution is appropriate for the public support repository and contains no proprietary product implementation code.
- [ ] It contains no secrets, license keys, credentials, private API definitions, personal/customer data, or sensitive logs.
- [ ] I have the right to publish contributed material under the repository's MIT License.
- [ ] Product status and planned capabilities are described conservatively.
